description: This file defines the 'Styles' class, which manages a collection of style objects within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, cloning, and serializing styles, as well as initializing built-in styles.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: Represents a collection of style objects, providing methods for managing styles, including adding, retrieving, cloning, and serializing styles, as well as initializing default styles.

classes.name: Styles.StylesValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for the Styles class, including a comment string.

methods.name: Styles()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the styles collection and sets up default styles.

methods.name: Styles(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Internal constructor that initializes the styles collection with a specified parent object.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Styles object.

methods.name: this[string? styleName]
methods.description: Indexer to retrieve a style by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to retrieve a style by its index.

methods.name: GetIndex(string styleName)
methods.description: Returns the index of a style by its name, or -1 if not found.

methods.name: AddStyle(string name, string baseStyleName)
methods.description: Adds a new style with specified name and base style, returning the created style.

methods.name: Add(DocumentObject? value)
methods.description: Adds a DocumentObject to the styles collection, expecting it to be a Style.

methods.name: SetupStyles()
methods.description: Initializes the collection with default built-in styles.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the styles collection into DDL format.

methods.name: SerializeStyle(Serializer serializer, int index, ref bool[] fSerialized, ref bool[] fSerializePending, ref bool newLine)
methods.description: Serializes a style and its base styles, handling dependencies and ordering.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor(DocumentObjectVisitor visitor, bool visitChildren)
methods.description: Allows a visitor to visit the styles collection and its styles.
